_comment: Person records the source published more than once for the same human. Each group collapses to `canonical`; `name` overrides the display name (default: the canonical record's own name). Only merge a group when the members' competitions are disjoint - build fails loudly otherwise. Candidates found but NOT merged are listed in the project doc claude/person-merges.md.
